name: theplanner
description: ThePlanner: a planner that turns your tasks, deadlines and available hours into a daily schedule, with reminders and a calendar feed.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
